current_sprint.title: Foundation, safety and de-risking
current_sprint.goal: Make the repository trustworthy as the source of truth, remove the credential leak risk, and run the three blocking hardware experiments that determine whether the product's headline features are feasible at all.

progress.note: Generated by scripts/project-tracker/render.py. Do not hand-edit.

honest_status.summary: Hardware capabilities are substantially proven but the product is not started. Three verified capabilities (GNSS, cellular LBS, 4G data) came out of hardware probing, not from the PRD. The PRD contains factual errors about this hardware that must be corrected. Three blocking experiments determine whether the headline features (NAT router, voice, speech) are feasible at all.
verified_and_usable: GNSS fix: 18.480776, 73.897998 in 69 s cold start
Cellular LBS fallback: +CLBS: 0,18.481703,73.897415,550, corroborated against the GNSS fix
Camera OV2640 live capture, SD card round trip (Arduino), outbound SMS, outgoing call control
not_yet_proven: End-to-end MQTT publish from the device to the broker (TASK-405, TEST-403 FAIL)
NAT routing and PPP data path (blocked on RISK-002)
honest_status.immediate_risk: RESOLVED 2026-09-29: the hardcoded broker credential in the tracker sketch has been removed. firmware/baseline/tracker/tracker.ino now includes a gitignored secrets.h and all 7 baseline sketches compile. The credential was visible outside this repository and must still be rotated at the broker; removal is not rotation.

next_action: Create the first commit, push to GitHub and enable Pages. Then run the three blocking experiments: TASK-020 PPP on the Airtel SIM, TASK-021 audio hardware population, TASK-022 GPS cold-start benchmark. Close ADR-005 (firmware framework) on the PPP outcome.
